current_answer: As checked November 7, Rockstar lists GTA 6 for November 19, 2026 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Both unlock at midnight local time in every region. Pre-load starts November 10: PS5 at local midnight, Xbox worldwide at 00:00 GMT. Rockstar says up to 212 GB may be needed depending on device. This is a public commitment, not a guarantee; two earlier targets moved. No official native PC date or window has been announced.

catalogue_card.question: What time does GTA 6 unlock, and when can I pre-load?
catalogue_card.text: Both consoles unlock at local midnight on November 19. Pre-load starts November 10, with up to 212 GB needed depending on device.

summary: Rockstar lists November 19, 2026 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Its support page says both versions release at midnight local time in every region; this is not one simultaneous worldwide UTC launch.
Pre-load is earlier than play access. PS5 starts at local midnight on November 10. Xbox starts globally at 00:00 GMT on November 10, which is November 9 in some time zones.

Rockstar says installation needs up to 212 GB depending on device. PlayStation Colombia support tells PS5 players to have 212 GB free. Rockstar has not published a per-console storage table or day-one patch size.
The code-in-box version contains no disc and is expected in retail from November 12. That date is not an early playable release.
Two earlier public targets moved. Launch logistics help with planning but do not prove the game is final, certified, or impossible to delay.
No official native PC date or window is listed. GamesBeat’s Q1 2027 report cites four anonymous sources; it is not a publisher commitment.
The October 26 review-code and November 18 embargo claims remain reported, not official. Review access does not prove a gold or certified build.
The latest inspected Cyberleek report says it could not authenticate new footage; the account and full-build claim remain unverified.
uncertainty: November 19 remains a public console commitment, not a delivery guarantee; two earlier target movements remain relevant.
The official local-midnight rule clarifies regional timing, but country-specific UTC conversions and Store metadata can change.
Rockstar says up to 212 GB depending on device; exact storage by console and a day-one patch size remain unknown.
The Q1 2027 PC window is an unconfirmed GamesBeat report from four anonymous sources.
Review-code distribution and the November 18 embargo are reported, not first-party announcements; they do not prove build completion or certification.
GinjFo’s October 28 update reports a Cyberleek return notice and poll but no newly authenticated footage; the account and full-build claim remain unverified.
freshness_note: Checked November 7, 2026. Rockstar Support now states a midnight-local launch on November 19 for both consoles and gives separate November 10 pre-load starts. Storage needs up to 212 GB depending on device.
